questions.question: For a circular cylinder in a uniform inviscid flow (ideal fluid, potential flow), the pressure distribution is symmetric about:
In real (viscous) flow over a circular cylinder at moderate Reynolds numbers, the main reason for asymmetric pressure distribution is:
According to potential flow theory, the stagnation points on a circular cylinder are located at:

answers.a: Top and bottom of the cylinder
answers.b: Front and rear of the cylinder (180<sup>o</sup> and 0<sup>o</sup>)
answers.c: 45<sup>o</sup> and 225<sup>o</sup> from the leading edge along the flow axis
